rules.title: Update docs with code
rules.text: Update README and docs in the same change that alters behavior.

rules.title: Document public APIs
rules.text: Document public functions, types and endpoints, including inputs, outputs and errors.

rules.title: TODOs need context
rules.text: Write TODOs with an owner or issue reference; do not leave bare TODOs.

rules.title: Prefer examples
rules.text: Show a short working example in docs for every non-trivial feature.

rules.title: README quickstart
rules.text: Keep the README quickstart working: install, run and test in a few commands.

rules.title: Document breaking changes
rules.text: Document breaking changes and migration steps wherever users will see them.

rules.title: Explain why
rules.text: Document decisions and trade-offs, not what the code visibly does.

rules.title: Diagrams as code
rules.text: Keep architecture diagrams as code (Mermaid, PlantUML) next to the docs they illustrate.

rules.title: Check links
rules.text: Use relative links for repository docs and keep them valid.

rules.title: Docs for user-visible changes
rules.text: Update rendered docs in the same PR for features, flags, config, environment variables, defaults and deprecations.

rules.title: Keep old URLs alive
rules.text: When you move or rename a documented public API, keep the old docs URL working with a redirect.
